USE WITH CAUTION

10 March, 1951

Stanislaw RETZLAW

RETZLAW @ Karl GROEHL and Babette GROSS-KLEPPER have produced a new periodical entitled "Aktion," which will be published in Frankfort-on-Main at the beginning of March.

Together with these two men, the contributors to the new periodical will mostly be ex-Communists.
